claims.text: Postvoid residual by catheterization or ultrasound: < 50 mL is normal; < 100 mL is usually acceptable over age 65.
claims.quote: In those who can void, incomplete bladder emptying is diagnosed by postvoid catheterization or ultrasound showing an elevated residual urine volume. A volume < 50 mL is normal; < 100 mL is usually acceptable in patients > 65 years but abnormal in younger patients.

claims.text: Further tests by clinical findings: urinalysis, blood tests, ultrasound, urodynamics, cystoscopy, cystography.
claims.quote: Other tests (eg, urinalysis, blood tests, ultrasound urodynamic testing, cystoscopy , cystography) are done based on clinical findings.

claims.text: Acute retention: relieve with urethral catheterization, then treat the cause.
claims.quote: Relief of acute urinary retention requires urethral catheterization . Subsequent treatment depends on cause.
